How this estimate is calculated

LLM: Connected calls × billed tokens per call × input/output rates, plus the provider usage buffer.

STT: Connected call minutes × the selected audio rate, plus the buffer.

TTS: Call minutes × agent speaking share × characters or bytes per speech minute, plus the buffer. Cartesia uses the lowest-cost paid plan plus overage from the supplied rate table, including its monthly subscription.

GPT Realtime Mini: Text tokens plus audio input and output, with no separate STT or TTS fees. Audio is estimated from caller and agent speaking time unless you enter billed audio tokens per call. The default audio estimate excludes repeated audio history; enter totals from your usage to include it. Optional input transcription is excluded.

Combined: LLM + STT + TTS + ₹1. Per-minute estimates divide monthly costs by connected call minutes. At zero minutes, a per-minute figure is not applicable.

Estimates use Truffl’s pricing rates and your selected usage assumptions. They are indicative quotes, not invoices. Estimates exclude telephony, taxes, implementation and negotiated discounts. Model selection here is for cost comparison and does not confirm production availability.
